messages.author: 10e4bf70cfdf41b9
messages.subject: Re: Problem with last CG version : none varaible can be computed and lots of others
parts: It turned out for me that compareGroups does not work with 'tibble' or "data_frame" object. Once I convert the dataset into regular data.frame using as.data.frame, the function works.

messages.author: 176185748932f5c0
messages.subject: Re: Problem with last CG version : none varaible can be computed and lots of others
parts: The latest compareGroups version (3.4.0) does support "tibble" objects.
